core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ragheb is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Desiring, longing”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ragheb corresponds to the Arabic form رَاغِب (Arabic root ر غ ب (r-gh-b); رَاغِب (Rāghib)). Its core sense is ragheb; desiring, longing. Ragheb is Arabic رَاغِب (Rāghib) 'desiring, longing', from the root ر غ ب (r-gh-b). The source gloss 'Melodic, Singer' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as raghib.

persian.name: راغب
persian.long_meaning: Ragheb (راغب) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن راغب، مشتاق است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: राग़िब

arabic.name: رَاغِب
